description: This file defines a React functional component named TableIconActionButton, which renders an icon button with optional tooltip, supporting different variants such as edit, delete, test, and navigation actions. It imports icon components from @heroicons/react, uses the Tooltip component from antd, and depends on a BaseActionButton component. It also defines mappings for variants to icons and classes.

methods.name: TableIconActionButton
methods.description: React functional component that renders an icon button with optional tooltip, based on provided props.
